method: MIXED, WITH AN UNUSUAL PROVENANCE. A1 and A2 are two AMH pages, paraphrased, no passage stored: the pharmacology, the serotonin toxicity and withdrawal tables, and the SSRI class detail. S1 is an OPEN RACGP AJGP article which AMH ITSELF NAMES as a useful resource for health professionals on its adverse-effects page -- the licensed source pointing at the open one. ⚠️ S1 IS A VIEWPOINT, NOT A GUIDELINE OR A REVIEW, it is dated DECEMBER 2021, and several of its claims are argued positions rather than settled findings; the guideline labels its epidemiological claims and its interpretive ones differently and says which is which. S2 is one paragraph of published CORRESPONDENCE replying to S1, quoted for one practical proposal. No claim from S1 or S2 is used to establish a dose, a drug choice or a clinical threshold.
